title: Juicy Charred Italian Lamb Cacio E Pepe
description: A high-protein Italian dish featuring lamb kidney, served in a lotus leaf wrap, inspired by the traditional cacio e pepe recipe with a charred and double-fry twist.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a bowl, mix together flour, eggs, and bread crumbs to create a batter.
Dip each lamb kidney strip into the batter, coating evenly.
Double-fry the lamb strips by frying them in olive oil at 350 degrees Fahrenheit for 2 minutes, then increasing the heat to 400 degrees Fahrenheit for an additional 2 minutes.
Char the fried lamb strips on a grill or grill pan for 1 minute on each side.
In a saucepan, combine grated pecorino romano cheese and black pepper, heating over low heat until the cheese is melted and the mixture is well combined.
Add the charred lamb strips to the cheese mixture and toss to coat.
Wrap each portion of the lamb and cheese mixture in a lotus leaf, securing with a toothpick if necessary.
Bake the wrapped lamb and cheese in the preheated oven for 10 minutes, or until the lotus leaves are tender and the filling is heated through.
Serve the juicy charred Italian lamb cacio e pepe hot, garnished with additional black pepper if desired.
